bedrockTitle: Plays through the Bedrock bridge (phone, console, Windows edition)
noEvents: Nobody has joined or left yet. The list fills up as soon as something happens – Hostwerk already knows who left in the last 24 hours.
noServersHint: Create a server in Hostwerk under Minecraft – it shows up here right away. Game servers from the extension “Game servers” appear as soon as they run.
obsHint: Add it in OBS as a “Browser” source – transparent, without Hostwerk around it. Options: ?theme=light, ?size=20, ?servers=1, ?count=0, ?server=<id>.
obsOff: There is an own address for OBS without sign-in. Switch on “Share the stream view without sign-in” in the settings – then anyone with the address sees who is playing.
site.oldText: Pages in a web server need Hostwerk with SDK 3.2. After the update this tab works by itself.
site.noWebText: Create a web server in Hostwerk (Apache, nginx or Caddy) – then the page can go into one of its folders.
site.pages: Who is online? – as a web page
site.none: No page yet – “Provide as a web page” puts one into a web server of yours.

site.privacy: The page is public for everyone who reaches the web server – it only shows server names, numbers and player names (as chosen above), no addresses or IDs.
